description: Pusta Zbroja, an empty suit of old dark steel plate armour standing on its own, a closed helmet with nothing inside but darkness and two faint violet glowing eyes in the visor slit, a red sash across the breastplate, a long sword raised in one gauntlet, clear solid shapes, eerie and menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the armour alone, no dust, no chains, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
